axes_culturels.description: The construction of individual and collective identities through intercultural exchanges within the English-speaking world.
exemples_objets_etude: Expatriation and student mobility (Erasmus, gap year)

axes_culturels.description: Issues of diversity (ethnic, social, gender) and inclusion policies in English-speaking societies.
exemples_objets_etude: Representation in media and popular culture

axes_culturels.description: The relationship between artistic creation and political, economic or social power in the English-speaking world.
exemples_objets_etude: Soft power and cultural diplomacy (Hollywood, BBC)

axes_culturels.description: Scientific and technological advances and the ethical questions they raise in English-speaking countries.
Interactions between humanity and the natural environment, ecological challenges in the English-speaking world.
In-depth study of American societies (USA, Canada, English-speaking Caribbean): history, culture, contemporary issues. Compulsory axis.
exemples_objets_etude: The American Dream: myth and reality
Segregation, civil rights and their current legacy
Hip-hop culture as a social vehicle

contraintes.note: 5 out of 6 axes must be covered during the year, including axis 6 (English-speaking Americas) which is compulsory.

comprehension_orale.descripteur: Understand lectures, speeches and broadcasts on concrete or abstract subjects, including technical discussions in one's field.

comprehension_ecrite.descripteur: Read articles and reports on contemporary issues, understand a contemporary literary prose text.

expression_orale.descripteur: Present clear, detailed descriptions on complex subjects, develop a point of view with arguments and examples.

expression_ecrite.descripteur: Write clear, detailed texts on various subjects, an essay or report conveying information or presenting reasons for or against an opinion.

interaction.descripteur: Communicate fluently and spontaneously, actively participate in conversation in familiar situations, present and defend opinions.

mediation.descripteur: Clearly convey the essence of a text or exchange, adapt register to the audience, facilitate intercultural communication.

grammaire: Modals of deduction (must be, can't be, might be)
Conditional type 3 (if + past perfect / would have + pp)
Passive voice (all tenses, impersonal passive: it is said that…)
Used to / would for past habits
Emphasis (cleft sentences: It is… that/who; What… is…)
Concession and opposition connectors (despite, in spite of, whereas, nevertheless)
